title: French Cashew Galette
description: A French-inspired savory tart filled with a garlicky cashew mixture, perfect for a dinner party. The combination of flavors and textures will delight your guests.
instructions: Roll out the french pastry and place on a baking sheet.
In a food processor, blend the soaked cashews, minced garlic, and grated cheese until smooth.
Spread the cashew mixture evenly over the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
